title: 🚌 Several Transportation Jobs Now Hiring in Statesville, NC
text:
1 days ago Statesville has some solid transportation and aviation openings right now, especially if you like hands-on work and being around aircraft or on the road.
Below are several on-site roles you can skim and click through in a minute.
Aircraft Interior Technician - 1288 Employer: West Star Aviation Inc. Location: Statesville, NC (on-site hangar/shop) Type: Full-time Salary: Not listed Work on high-end private aircraft interiors—carpet, seats, panels, and cabin details. Good fit if you have hands-on skills, can lift up to 70 lbs, and want steady hours with benefits that start on day one.
Aircraft Maintenance Technician - 1052 Employer: West Star Aviation Inc. Location: Statesville, NC (on-site hangar) Type: Full-time Salary: Not listed Keep some of the most advanced civilian aircraft flying—inspections, repairs, troubleshooting, and engine work. Great if you hold an A&P license , like variety in your day, and don’t mind working rotating shifts.
Note: There’s another posting for this same role under a different link; it’s the same job.
Lead Aircraft Maintenance Technician - 1679 Employer: West Star Aviation Inc. Location: Statesville, NC (on-site hangar) Type: Full-time Salary: Not listed Step up to lead a team of techs—assign work, manage aircraft turn times, and handle complex inspections and troubleshooting. Best for experienced A&P mechanics (about 8+ years in aviation maintenance) ready for leadership.
